### No King Like Him (no, not Him)
Author: Peter Orr
Site: The Gospel Coalition | Australia
URL: https://au.thegospelcoalition.org/article/no-king-like-him-no-not-him/
Passage: 2 Kings 23:25
Points:
- Scripture describes Josiah's wholehearted devotion in unmatched terms, placing him above even David.
- Josiah executed thorough reforms across the land, cleansing idolatry and restoring the national Passover.
- Despite his obedience, Josiah could not avert God's impending judgment against the nation's past sins.
- Josiah's ultimate inability to save Judah demonstrates the seriousness and weight of divine wrath.
- Jesus fulfills Josiah's standard of complete devotion while successfully bearing God's wrath to save His people.

### Bible Pathway - May 10
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-may-10-2013.html
Passage: 2 Kings 23:21-25
Points:
- Josiah chose to walk with God from a young age despite the wicked patterns of previous kings.
- He relied fully on God for protection rather than turning to ungodly alliances.
- His wholehearted dedication and obedience surpassed even David, Solomon, and Hezekiah.
- Josiah's restored Passover foreshadowed Jesus Christ as the true Lamb who delivers believers from death.
- Believers are challenged to examine whether their own lives display similar wholehearted devotion.
